RegistrationInfo.Description: W365 thin client (SCRIPT-FREE, FALLBACK v2): same as W365-LogoffOnStandbyWake-V2 but WITHOUT the DurationInUs floor - use only if the pilot build's Task Scheduler rejects the numeric comparison in the trigger query. Fires on every Lid (15) / Power Button (1) / Input Keyboard (31) / Input Touchpad (33) / User Input (4) standby exit, including short lid flaps. Reason codes verified on Bruce's pilot build Oct 12, 2026.

EventTrigger.Subscription: <QueryList><Query Id="0" Path="System"><Select Path="System">*[System[Provider[@Name='Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Power'] and (EventID=507)] and EventData[(Data[@Name='Reason']=15 or Data[@Name='Reason']=1 or Data[@Name='Reason']=31 or Data[@Name='Reason']=33 or Data[@Name='Reason']=4)]]</Select></Query></QueryList>
